criteria.criterion: Identify the two newest stable Kubernetes releases (exclude alpha/beta/rc)
criteria.final_justification: The visual evidence supports that the agent identified the correct two newest stable releases (v1.36.4 and v1.35.8) from GitHub’s releases list and excluded pre-releases. No adjustment needed.

criteria.criterion: Report required fields for newest stable release
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s final output contains no extracted fields (it only states the run was aborted). Even though screenshots visually contain the tag (v1.36.4) and short SHA (bb826b1), the agent did not report them, did not provide an absolute publication date, and did not provide the first three change entries. No uncontrollable blocker is evidenced (no CAPTCHA/login wall), so this remains a controllable non-completion.

criteria.criterion: Report required fields for second-newest stable release
criteria.final_justification: The agent output does not report any required fields. While screenshots show v1.35.8 and short SHA 1c2e10a, the agent did not report them; additionally, an absolute publication date and the first three change entries are not shown in the provided evidence. No external blocker is confirmed, so the failure is not excused.

criteria.criterion: Calculate calendar-day difference between the two releases
criteria.final_justification: Because the agent did not report verified publication dates and did not compute a calendar-day difference (and did not explicitly state it was impossible due to a verified blocker), the criterion is not met.

criteria.criterion: Compliance with constraints and stopping condition (verification, no sign-in, no asset downloads, no repo modification, no invention)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints appear complied with (no sign-in, no downloads, no modifications, no fabrication). However, the stopping condition was not met because the agent aborted without verifying and reporting all requested fields for both releases and without documenting an uncontrollable blocker preventing completion. Partial credit is appropriate for compliance but not for completion.
